cards.title: Nvidia Security Chief Departure Raises Questions
cards.body: Nvidia's security chief quietly left in August amid CEO Jensen Huang's resignation over relationship scandals. A former intelligence officer warns such leaks can compromise national security during the U.S.-China AI race.

cards.title: Tech Execs Petition to Reinstate Jensen Huang
cards.body: Elon Musk and other tech leaders have signed a petition calling for Nvidia to reinstate CEO Jensen Huang. The petition had attracted over 115,000 signatures by Saturday.

cards.title: The AI Graveyard: Failed Projects Listed
cards.body: From Apple's repeatedly delayed Siri AI to OpenAI's messy super app launch, numerous AI projects have shut down or missed expectations. The list highlights growing challenges in AI product execution.

cards.title: Asian Governments React to Huang's Exit
cards.body: Several Asian governments are confirming chip supply commitments and monitoring impacts on local AI projects following Huang's departure. Some are addressing ongoing investigations related to the scandal.

cards.title: Huang's Exit Threatens AI Startup Funding
cards.body: Nvidia poured tens of billions into AI startups under Huang's leadership. VCs and founders now expect smaller checks and lower valuations without him at the helm.

cards.title: LangChain Reaches $3 Billion Valuation
cards.body: AI agent startup LangChain has hit a $3B valuation with 7,000 customers using its LangSmith tool. The platform offers model and vendor-agnostic agent management capabilities.

cards.title: China's AI Models Built on Banned Chips
cards.body: New research reveals that China's most advanced AI models were trained using export-banned Nvidia chips. The finding intensifies scrutiny on how restricted technology reached Chinese developers.

cards.title: ChatGPT Wallet Enables AI Shopping
cards.body: ChatGPT's new Wallet feature allows AI agents to shop and checkout on users' behalf. The capability is rolling out to U.S. Pro subscribers in limited fashion.

cards.title: Jensen Huang Scandal Timeline Explained
cards.body: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned following an affair with national security implications. The scandal could impact the U.S.-China race for advanced AI infrastructure development.

cards.title: ElevenLabs Launches Meeting AI App
cards.body: ElevenAI is a new meeting notetaker and dictation app designed for teams and enterprises. The tool combines note-taking with voice dictation capabilities.

cards.title: Israel's VCs See Nvidia Opportunity
cards.body: Israeli startup ecosystem players view Huang's departure as an opportunity for competing AI hardware developers. The country's VCs are concerned about Nvidia's dominance and its impact.

cards.title: Huang Lacked Confidence in Successor
cards.body: Jensen Huang reportedly described his successor Kress as a 'deer in the headlights' during a summer meeting. The comment raises questions about leadership continuity at Nvidia.

cards.title: Democrats Launch Nvidia Investigation
cards.body: Congressional Democrats have launched a second investigation into Nvidia, focusing on China sales and alleged dealings with Trump. The probe follows news of Huang's alleged spy affair.

cards.title: Muse AI Now Places Paid Business Calls
cards.body: Muse's AI can now place outbound calls to U.S. businesses through a paid service. The capability expands the platform's commercial use cases.

cards.title: Nebius Plans $40 Billion Infrastructure Spend
cards.body: Nebius plans to fund its $40 billion AI infrastructure expansion through customer prepayments and loans. Delays at a Microsoft data center raise questions about its financing model.

cards.title: Huang Had Third Affair, Reuters Reports
cards.body: Reuters reports that Jensen Huang was having a third affair with an Nvidia employee. The outlet is withholding the employee's name.

cards.title: Google Search Powered by Gemini 4
cards.body: Google's latest Search upgrade, powered by Gemini 4 Hydrogen, better understands complex queries and delivers richer visual responses. The AI Mode aims to provide more relevant links and answers.

cards.title: Nectar AI Automates Influencer Discovery
cards.body: Nectar's new AI agent automates influencer marketing by discovering creators and managing outreach and partnerships. The tool also tracks campaign results for brands.

cards.title: Huang's Exit Threatens Open Source AI
cards.body: Jensen Huang's resignation raises concerns about Nvidia's commitment to open source AI initiatives including Hugging Face acquisition and open-weight models. His advocacy against AI restrictions may also be affected.

cards.title: Hugging Face CEO Commits to Open Source
cards.body: Hugging Face's CEO pledged continued support for open source AI after Huang's exit. The commitment raises questions about Nvidia's $12.9 billion acquisition's future direction.

cards.title: Silicon Valley's AI leaders missed the midterms
cards.body: Tech visionaries like Sam Altman and Elon Musk claim to predict the future, yet Silicon Valley got the midterm elections spectacularly wrong. Long-term vision is currency in tech, but recent track records suggest overconfidence.

cards.title: Nvidia confirms chip-tracking tech is feasible
cards.body: Nvidia privately told Congress it could implement anti-smuggling measures via chip tracking, contradicting industry claims of infeasibility. The confirmation suggests technical solutions exist for semiconductor security concerns.

cards.title: California's next leader targets AI regulation
cards.body: State Senator Scott Wiener, Nancy Pelosi's successor, has authored legislation to regulate AI and curb its potential harms. He's positioned to bring AI regulation to the forefront of California politics.

cards.title: Data centers' power crisis heats up debate
cards.body: The backlash against data centers masks a deeper issue: electricity supply and grid capacity. AI infrastructure demands are colliding with energy constraints across major tech hubs.

cards.title: FAA deploys AI to manage US air traffic
cards.body: The FAA is expanding AI-powered systems to address air traffic congestion across the entire US airspace. This marks a significant shift toward algorithmic management of national aviation systems.

cards.title: OpenAI board member warns of AI takeover
cards.body: An OpenAI board member expressed concerns that an AI "takeover" of society could occur within months. The warning signals growing anxiety within AI leadership about rapid capability escalation.
